{{- /* layouts/_partials/page-slug.html Content slug for search / explorer / graph (legacy Quartz rules). Input: page context (uses .RelPermalink and .Site.BaseURL). Contract (arch/03): RelPermalink is a root-relative path (/demo/quartz/1.name/filea.html). Slug = path minus baseURL prefix, minus .html and trailing /index. Homepage → "index". If RelPermalink is still an absolute URL (non-contract Foundry behaviour when baseURL included a host), drop scheme+host first so Explorer does not treat "https" / hostname as folders. */ -}} {{- $raw := .RelPermalink | default "" -}} {{- $path := $raw -}} {{- if or (strings.HasPrefix $raw "https://") (strings.HasPrefix $raw "http://") -}} {{- $rest := $raw | strings.TrimPrefix "https://" | strings.TrimPrefix "http://" -}} {{- $segs := split $rest "/" -}} {{- $path = "" -}} {{- range $i, $s := $segs -}} {{- if gt $i 0 -}} {{- $path = printf "%s/%s" $path $s -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- $path = $path | strings.TrimPrefix "/" -}} {{- $basePath := partial "base-url-path.html" . -}} {{- $slug := $path -}} {{- if $basePath -}} {{- $slug = $path | strings.TrimPrefix $basePath | strings.TrimPrefix "/" -}} {{- end -}} {{- $slug = $slug | strings.TrimSuffix ".html" | strings.TrimSuffix "/index" -}} {{- if or (eq $slug "") (eq $slug "/") (eq $slug "index") -}} index {{- else -}} {{- $slug -}} {{- end -}}
